Dr. Martinez, patient Aisha Rahman (age 72) presents with: Hip fracture s/p ORIF, post-op day 3, ready for discharge planning. Relevant history: Osteoporosis (on alendronate); Atrial fibrillation (on warfarin, INR 2.3 today); CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Current medications: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR target 2.0-3.0), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, and 2 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503), age 72, hip fracture s/p ORIF post-op day 3, preparing for discharge. Please reconcile the discharge medication list: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3, target 2.0-3.0), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID. Note CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Verify no interactions and dosing adjustments needed. Also confirm if there are additional discharge medications to review.
I'm reconciling the discharge medication list for Aisha Rahman. Checking for interactions, renal dosing adjustments, and approval status.

Patient PT-41503 medication reconciliation complete. Discharge medication list reviewed: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3, in target range), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, Oxycodone 5mg q6h PRN, Docusate 100mg BID. No contraindications identified. Warfarin requires ongoing INR monitoring; alendronate appropriate for osteoporosis; renal function adequate for current dosing. Safe for discharge approval.
Thank you for the completed medication reconciliation. Please coordinate with the nurse agent to ensure discharge instructions incorporate the medication list and follow-up arrangements are in place.

Discharge approved for Aisha Rahman (PT-41503): Home discharge, hip fracture s/p ORIF post-op day 3, stable. Please prepare discharge instructions incorporating the reconciled medication list (Warfarin 5mg daily, Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, Oxycodone 5mg q6h PRN, Docusate 100mg BID), arrange INR follow-up monitoring, and confirm post-acute care arrangements.
